stem.en: A ball is thrown horizontally off a cliff at the same instant a second ball is simply dropped from the same height. Which hits the ground first?
stem.et: Pall visatakse kaljult horisontaalselt samal hetkel, mil teine pall lastakse samalt kõrguselt lihtsalt lahti. Kumb jõuab enne maapinnale?

label.en: Neither — both hit at the same time, since their vertical motions are identical
label.et: Kumbki mitte — mõlemad jõuavad samal ajal, sest nende vertikaalliikumine on identne

label.en: The dropped ball, since the thrown one has extra distance to cover
label.et: Lahti lastud pall, sest visatud pallil on rohkem läbimist vaja

label.en: The thrown ball, since it has extra speed to help it down
label.et: Visatud pall, sest sellel on lisakiirus, mis aitab tal alla jõuda

label.en: It depends on how hard the first ball was thrown
label.et: See sõltub sellest, kui kõvasti esimest palli visati
